sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant prays for and is permitted to withdraw this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C in relation to Crime No.118 of 2024 registered at PS Panihar, District Gwalior for offence punishable under Sections 498A, 304-B of IPC.
Accordingly, the instant bail application stands dismissed as withdrawn.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE *VJ*
